feats.title: Fated Survival
feats.description: When you fail a saving throw, you gain a +2 feat bonus to the next saving throw you make against the same effect.

feats.title: Occult Reach
feats.description: When using a close implement attack power, you can choose a square within 2 squares of yours as the origin square. You are still excluded from the area of the attack. At 21st level, you can choose a square within 3 squares of your square.

feats.title: Defensive Advantage
feats.description: When you have combat advantage against an enemy, you gain a +2 bonus to AC against that enemy's attacks.

feats.title: Uncanny Dodge
feats.description: Choose an ability other than Dexterity or Intelligence. While wearing light armor or no armor, you can use this ability in place of Dexterity or Intelligence to determine your AC.
